content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce infrastructure is a suite of free and paid tools that enable digital creators to design, document, and deploy their own commerce stacks. Unlike traditional commerce platforms, which charge high fees and exert control over the creator's business, COREMERCH's infrastructure gives creators full ownership and control over their commerce operations. With COREMERCH, creators can sell design assets, such as ebooks, courses, templates, and fonts, using a variety of cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and USDT.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of COREMERCH's infrastructure is a combination of GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase. These tools work together to create a seamless and automated commerce experience for customers. When a customer purchases a design asset, they are taken to a secure payment page where they can pay using their preferred cryptocurrency. Once the payment is confirmed, the assets are automatically delivered to the customer via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, eliminating the need for manual intervention. The order data is stored in Supabase, providing creators with a centralized and secure location to manage their sales.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators who are locked out of traditional commerce platforms due to geographical restrictions or high fees. This includes creators from countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines, where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. By providing a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, COREMERCH empowers these creators to build and scale their businesses, free from the constraints of traditional commerce platforms.

COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce infrastructure is not a workaround, but a base-layer solution that empowers creators to build and scale their businesses, free from the constraints of traditional commerce platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of COREMERCH's infrastructure include a range of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments. Each tool plays a critical role in creating a seamless and automated commerce experience for customers. For example, GitHub Pages provides a secure hosting environment for creators' commerce stacks, while Cloudflare Workers automates the delivery of digital assets to customers. NOWPayments provides a secure and reliable payment gateway, enabling creators to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, creators can start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. This comprehensive package provides everything creators need to build, deploy, and scale their own digital commerce stack. Alternatively, creators can choose to deploy the Sovereign Starter Stack, which includes the essential tools and support for launching a basic commerce stack. Regardless of the choice, creators can rest assured that they will have full ownership and control over their commerce operations, free from the constraints of traditional commerce platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question a reader would ask is, 'How do I save money by using COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce infrastructure?' The answer is simple: by avoiding the high fees charged by traditional commerce platforms. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between Gumroad's 10% and NOWPayments' 0.5% amounts to $921, a significant retention of profit for creators.
By avoiding the high fees charged by traditional commerce platforms, creators can retain up to 921 dollars per month in profit.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce infrastructure is perfect for digital creators who want to sell design assets with crypto payments, without relying on Stripe or any other platform. With the Complete Builder Kit, creators can instantly download everything they need to build, deploy, and scale their own digital commerce stack. Learn more about COREMERCH's products, including the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Edge Commerce Stack, at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. By deploying COREMERCH's infrastructure, creators can join the ranks of successful entrepreneurs who are building and scaling their businesses, free from the constraints of traditional commerce platforms.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: purchase the Complete Builder Kit or the Sovereign Starter Stack; choose the right tools and configurations for your commerce stack; set up your payment gateway with NOWPayments; configure your hosting environment with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages; automate the delivery of digital assets with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script; and finally, store your order data in Supabase. By following these steps, creators can build and deploy their own sovereign digital commerce stack, free from the constraints of traditional commerce platforms.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Edge Commerce Stack?

The Sovereign Starter Stack includes the essential tools and support for launching a basic commerce stack, while the Edge Commerce Stack includes the advanced tools and configurations for creating a more complex commerce stack, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing.
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my commerce stack?

To integrate NOWPayments, creators can follow the NOWPayments integration guide, which is included in the Complete Builder Kit. This guide provides a step-by-step walkthrough of the integration process, including configuring the payment gateway and automating the delivery of digital assets.
What is the recommended network for low fees?
The recommended network for low fees is BSC, Solana, or TRON, which have transaction fees under $0.10.
Can I sell digital assets outside of the provided blueprints?
Yes, creators can sell digital assets outside of the provided blueprints, as long as they follow the required configurations and integrations for their chosen tools and payment gateway.
How do I update my commerce stack with new features and tools?

Creators can update their commerce stack with new features and tools by following the provided documentation and guides, which include step-by-step instructions for deploying new components and configuring existing ones.
